name: manual_f2c641
claim: Hermes-Harness integration with GLM-5.2: both orama-system (canonical) and PT (thin wrapper) hermes-harness skills now document that when LM Studio or other Hermes-accessible models are unavailable on Windows, the task queue automatically falls back to GLM-5.2. This is wired by start.ps1 (Windows orchestrator). No additional setup beyond the one-time Mac-side bootstrap. Hermes is the operator shell for ECC workflows; GLM-5.2 ensures that shell can execute any queued task even when primary models fail.
conditions: hermes harness windows glm52 fallback lmstudio unavailable

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04: Hermes runs on Windows with LM Studio as primary; GLM-5.2 is now explicitly documented as the fallback for Hermes-queued tasks when LM Studio is unavailable.

rationale: Session 2026-07-04: Hermes runs on Windows with LM Studio as primary; GLM-5.2 is now explicitly documented as the fallback for Hermes-queued tasks when LM Studio is unavailable.
